PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # CS gain device gm/Id (sets Vgs1 = Vout_dc)
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # gain device / mirror L
    "k_sf":  (1.2, 0.6, 1.6),        # follower bias current = k_sf * IREF
    "gmid_sf": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),   # follower gm/Id
    "L_sf":  (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),
    "Rf":    (500e3, 440e3, 650e3),  # feedback resistor
    "Cf":    (2e-15, 0.2e-15, 15e-15),  # damping cap across Rf
    "Rb":    (10e6, 3e6, 30e6),      # mirror-gate filter resistor
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.0

    # M1: CS gain device, drain current = IREF (IREF feeds gain node directly)
    I1 = iref
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.0)
    vin_dc = m1.vgs                       # vout_dc == vgs1 (no DC current in Rf)

    # follower M2 and its sink M3 (mirror of M1)
    Isf = p["k_sf"] * I1
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], p["L_sf"], Isf, vds=vdd - vin_dc, vsb=vin_dc)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Isf, vds=vin_dc)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "ibias", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "gb", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.R("Rb", "iin", "gb", p["Rb"])
    Cb = 1e-12
    n.C("Cb", "gb", "vss", Cb)
    n.R("Rf", "vout", "iin", p["Rf"])
    n.C("Cf", "vout", "iin", p["Cf"])

    # small-signal model
    a_sf = m2.gm / (m2.gm + m2.gmbs + m2.gds + m3.gds + 1.0 / p["Rf"])
    Gx = m1.gds
    A0 = (m1.gm / Gx) * a_sf
    Cx = m1.cdd + m2.cgd + (m2.cgg - m2.cgd) * (1 - a_sf) + 2e-15
    wx = Gx / Cx
    Go = m2.gm + m2.gmbs + m2.gds + m3.gds + 1.0 / p["Rf"]
    Co = cl + m3.cdd + (m2.cgg - m2.cgd) * (1 - a_sf) + 3e-15
    wo = Go / Co
    Cin = cpd + (m1.cgg - m1.cgd) + 2e-15
    Cf_eff = p["Cf"] + m1.cgd / max(a_sf, 0.3)

    f = np.logspace(4, 9.5, 3000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    Zf = 1.0 / (1.0 / p["Rf"] + s * Cf_eff)
    A = A0 / ((1 + s / wx) * (1 + s / wo))
    Zt = 1.0 / ((s * Cin + 1.0 / Zf) / A + 1.0 / Zf)
    mag = np.abs(Zt)
    z0 = mag[0]
    below = np.where(mag < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[below[0]]) if len(below) else float(f[-1])

    # noise at 1 MHz, referred to the photodiode node
    w1 = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = kT4 * 0.8 / m1.gm
    in2 = kT4 / p["Rf"] + kT4 / p["Rb"] + en2 * (w1 * (Cin + Cf_eff)) ** 2
    in_noise = math.sqrt(in2)

    power = vdd * (iref + Isf)
    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "power": power,
        "in_noise_1m": in_noise,
        "vout_dc": vin_dc,
    }
